record.body:
## Problem

CI runs no Node tooling. A broken Svelte or TypeScript change merges unchecked. The repo has no lint or format standard for TypeScript and Svelte, and `AGENTS.md` has no section for them.

## Approach

Add a `web` CI job that installs, type-checks, tests, and builds the UI. Add a lint and format tool. Verify the current Biome support for Svelte first. If it is too weak, use ESLint with Prettier. Add a TypeScript and Svelte section to `AGENTS.md`. The UI stays at `dashboard/web/ui` in this phase. Decide the exact commands at plan-phase.

## Exit criteria

- The CI `web` job runs `npm ci`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` in the UI directory. A deliberate type error on a branch fails the job (observation in a CI run).
- `npm run lint` exits 0 on the tree (command).
- `AGENTS.md` has a TypeScript and Svelte standards section (`grep -n "Svelte" AGENTS.md`).
- Every acceptance passes, and the CI `web` job passes on a pushed branch (integration check through the real entry point).
